{{dablink|For other uses of the word "wing," see [[Wing]].}}
'''Sho-wings''' were one of the many technological wonders that existed during the [[Age of Legends]]. They were transportation vehicles that ranged in shape and size, although the most common form was a delta-shape.

Sho-wings were designed for carrying passengers - numbering from few to the hundreds - over large distances, similar to other vehicles known as [[jo-car]]s, jumpers, and hoverflies.

Allegedly, immediately after the [[Breaking of the World|Breaking]] began, sho-wings disappeared from existence, and not even tales of them managed to survive to the [[Third Age]]. However, [[Ishamael|Moridin]] was known to have collected a number of parts to one, which he kept in a secret facility alongside other salvaged technology from the Age of Legends.
